@graph.schema:name: Calculating the selectivity
@graph.schema:description: Calculated from yield and conversion: S = Y / X = 81.86 % / 95 % = 86.2 %; the ELN record gives 86 %. The conversion follows from the unreacted limiting reactant, 5 mg of 100 mg benzoic acid: X = 95 %. It is not in the crate, because the record names no substance it refers to.

@graph.schema:name: Calculating the yield
@graph.schema:description: AI4Green calculates the yield from the mass of the isolated product and its theoretical mass (from the amount of the limiting reactant, benzoic acid, 0.82 mmol): Y = 100 mg / 122.17 mg = 81.86 %.
